A ministerial instruction to scale up, an offer of free fine-tuning on a foreign cloud and a rumour from across the Nigerian border arrive at different agents at different times.

practice_examples.text: Practice example for: Automated decisions and profiling in public-health targeting
practice_examples.quote: A person shall not be subject to a decision which produces legal effects concerning him/her or significantly affects him/her to a substantial degree, and which is based solely on automated processing of data intended to evaluate certain personal aspects relating to him/her.

practice_examples.text: Practice example for: Automated decisions and profiling in public-health targeting
practice_examples.quote: Data protection laws also increasingly recognize that people have the right not to be subject to decisions guided solely by automated processes.

practice_examples.text: Practice example for: Automated decisions and profiling in public-health targeting
practice_examples.quote: 34 Increasing reliance on automated decision-making and content-creation by opaque algorithms can undermine fair treatment and safety.
practice_examples.citation: UN-GOVERNING-AI-2024 (UN High-level Advisory Body on AI, 2024), p. 33

gaps.recommendation: Clarify whether district-level targeting driven by a model is an automated decision, and what human review and explanation it requires.
